data.name: Sanwar
data.gender_notes: Sanwar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sanwar is a Hindu name that means 'God of the Mountains'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'San' meaning 'God' and 'War' meaning 'Mountain'. This name is a reflection of the power and strength found in nature and is often given to boys who are believed to possess similar qualities. The name Sanwar carries the meaning “God of the Mountains” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sanwar usually hope their child will grow to embody god of the mountains and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sanwar is a name that represents the divine power of the mountains and the strength and stability they provide. It is a name that inspires a deep connection with nature and a sense of inner power and resilience.
data.etymology: Sanwar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of the Mountains.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sanwar total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
